body.heading: Find a puddle
paragraphs: After rain, walk with your adult and find a still puddle in a safe place.
Stand beside it and look down. You might see the sky, a tree, or your own wellies.

body.heading: Spot the picture
paragraphs: The reflection wobbles when a drop falls or a breeze blows. Watch it settle back into a picture.
Your adult can take a photo, or you can draw the reflection when you get home.

takeaway: A puddle is a mirror the rain leaves behind.
safetyNotes: Puddles are for looking at, not for drinking; stay away from roads and wash hands after outdoor play.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a puddle picture from memory and add the reflection you wish you had seen.
